name: Baby
description: Fed up with their families and classmates, two teen girls from a wealthy part of Rome are drawn to the city's underworld and start leading double lives.

videos.title: Superpowers
videos.overview: At an exclusive private high school, student athlete Chiara forges an unlikely bond with rebellious classmate Ludovica and mysterious new boy Damiano.

videos.title: Puppet
videos.overview: Chiara gets a peace offering from her dad. Camilla makes an offhand comment that impacts Chiara's love life. Ludo suffers a blow at a family event.

videos.title: #Friendzone
videos.overview: Chiara begs Camilla for a chance to explain things, Nico and Brando plot against Damiano, and Fiore offers Ludo a solution to her money troubles.

videos.title: Emma
videos.overview: Saverio introduces Ludo to an admirer who saw her at the club. Fabio helps Damiano out of a bind. A run-in at a party leads Chiara to act recklessly.

videos.title: The Last Shot
videos.overview: Ludo gets infuriating news, Chiara and her parents start therapy, and Saverio invites the girls to a secret party, where a familiar face shows up.

videos.title: #Love
videos.overview: In the aftermath, Ludo, Damiano and Chiara try to cover their tracks and grapple with feelings of guilt and fear. Fabio savors a life-changing moment.

videos.title: #justagame
videos.overview: As a new school year begins, Chiara helps Ludo deal with a troublesome client, and Damiano takes on another job to pay down his debt to Fiore.

videos.title: The Offer
videos.overview: Fiore surprises Chiara at school and takes her on a drive. Ludo locks horns with her new teacher. Damiano's late-night exploits leave him drained.

videos.title: Ghosts
videos.overview: Nagging suspicions drive a wedge between Chiara and Damiano. Brando is forced to choose sides when Nico and the others attack Fabio at school.

videos.title: Truth or Dare
videos.overview: While a shell-shocked Chiara braces for fallout from the incident at Marge, Brando scrambles to shore up his tough-guy image -- at school and at home.

videos.title: Dead End
videos.overview: Ludo's mother drops a bombshell, Damiano tries to make sense of Chiara's sudden change of heart, and Chiara meets Brando's family.

videos.title: Baby
videos.overview: As Brando's latest video sends shock waves through Collodi, Chiara plots her revenge, and Ludo seeks refuge from her stalker.

videos.title: Valentine's Day
videos.overview: When an acquaintance is caught in a police raid, Chiara and Ludo worry for their safety. A private investigator offers Damiano a deal.

videos.title: April 26th, 1915
videos.overview: A story on a gossip site sends rumors flying at Collodi — and prompts Ludo to make big changes. Damiano sneaks a camera into Fiore's spare apartment.

videos.title: Make a Wish
videos.overview: On the eve of her 18th birthday, a defiant Ludo accepts a challenge from Virginia. Meanwhile, Chiara faces one unsettling surprise after another.

videos.title: No More Secrets
videos.overview: As her new life begins to unravel, Ludo makes a desperate move. A TV interview puts Chiara in a difficult position. Damiano opens up to Aurora.

videos.title: 100 Days
videos.overview: While Chiara deals with the fallout from her post, Ludo searches for an escape, Damiano seeks advice from Monica, and Brando confronts his father.

videos.title: Beyond the Aquarium
videos.overview: As the case goes to trial, Chiara and Ludo weigh their options for the future and scour Rome for the one person who could help bring Fiore to justice.
